name: 遗落背包
prompt: Create exactly ONE transparent game prop sprite. References 1/2 are fixed style: strong dark hand-drawn contours, broad painted light and shade masses, readable forms with some brush texture; do NOT copy their pedestal. Reference 3 and 5 are approved final furniture style and localized wear. Reference 4 is the floor projection: orthographic, camera elevation45°, ground axes +/-0.7071, vertical edges vertical, tile144x101.82. Plan ground footprint BEFORE illustration; bottom contact corners must follow the template. Small top-down 3/4 view, two clear faces. Full object, generous transparent margins, NO floor/platform/pedestal/text/cast shadow. Upper-left light, restrained worn teal/ochre/cream/charcoal palette, modern industrial salvage society with repair/reuse, not medieval treasure nor nuclear wasteland. Readable at actual 144px grid scale, shape detail not photographic noise. A small slumped olive canvas hiking backpack with patched fabric, chunky zipper, a tied cloth carry strap and one empty side pocket. Main flap fastened, filled but not oversized. Ground .45x.4tile, vertical height26px at tile144. Modern salvaged practical bag, two or three big fabric folds, isolated no floor. Unsearched. Absolutely NO halo, NO surrounding glow, NO semi-transparent smoky background. Outside the hard object silhouette must be fully transparent.
